pilot: P2 certified DESI DR2 BAO likelihood: chi^2 interval at the fit point, EdS exclusion, excluded Omega_m bands (docs/RESEARCH_DIRECTIONS_2026-10-08.md R1, extended)
authorised_by: user: 'continue on such research directions and go further leveraging existing dataset on cosmology and lean 4 and MCP for rusty-sundials, leanmaster, leanflow and autoevolveAI and socrateAI projects and folders' (2026-10-08)
stage: preregistration: committed before any P2 Lean file, table or likelihood value was computed. Known before registration: the P1 results; DESI's published Om = 0.2975 +- 0.0086; the rusty-SUNDIALS README values (chi2_min 10.2710 at the fit point, chi2 11089 for EdS at fixed h r_d). No profile chi^2 over Om has been computed by us.
data: DESI DR2 BAO ALL_GCcomb mean (13 points) and covariance (block diagonal: one 1x1 D_V block, six 2x2 D_M/D_H blocks), /mnt/disks/disk-socrateai-local-1/dualscale-data-r3/desi_sdss_bao/desi_bao_dr2/, decimals taken as exact rationals; P = C^-1 computed exactly over Q
model: flat LCDM, radiation off; base quantities x_j(Om): chi(z) for D_M rows, 1/E(z) for D_H rows, w(z) = (z chi(z)^2 / E(z))^(1/3) for the D_V row; prediction = K x_j with K = c/(100 h r_d) > 0; chi2(Om, K) = sum_jk P_jk (d_j - K x_j)(d_k - K x_k)
method: Lean 4.34.1 + Mathlib d13f23b7 (pinned stack), pinned imports, autoImplicit off, axiom whitelist {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}, no native_decide
an expression type with a rational interval evaluator and a soundness theorem proved once; chi2 and its K-coefficients are expressions generated by Lean functions from the data lists
for every K: chi2 = c - K B + K^2 A, so A > 0 gives chi2 >= c - B^2/(4A) for all real K (profiling over h r_d)
chi, 1/E and w are antitone in Om on [0,1] for z >= 0, so for Om in [a, b] each x_j lies between its certified values at b (lower) and a (upper)
tables as in P1 (S = 2000); the fit-point table uses S = 20000 for a narrower chi2 interval
untrusted cross-checks: rusty-SUNDIALS through its MCP server (sundials-mcp, stdio JSON-RPC) and Python

hypotheses.H6: A kernel-checked interval for chi2(0.29743, K_fit) with K_fit = 299792458/10154300 (h r_d = 101.543) contains the rusty-SUNDIALS value 10.2710; its width is reported (no threshold).
hypotheses.H7: Kernel-checked: for every real K, chi2(Om = 1, K) >= X_EdS with X_EdS >= 1000 (Einstein-de Sitter is excluded by DESI DR2 BAO alone at any h r_d).
hypotheses.H8: Kernel-checked slab bounds L_s with: for all Om in slab s and all real K, chi2(Om, K) >= L_s. A slab is EXCLUDED when L_s > U_fit + 25, U_fit the upper end of the H6 interval (Delta chi2 > 25 against a certified upper bound of the minimum). Prediction: the excluded slabs cover [0, 0.24] and [0.36, 1].

controls.C4 (positive): the rusty-SUNDIALS chi2 at the fit point (from its MCP server or crate) lies inside the H6 interval; the MCP profile chi2_min(Om) on a fine Om grid is >= L_s inside every slab s
controls.C5 (negative): the control slab [0.29, 0.30], which contains the fit point, must NOT be excluded (L_s <= U_fit); if it were, the method would be unsound or mis-specified
controls.C6 (negative): a copy with one DESI value shifted by +10 sigma must give an H6 interval that excludes 10.2710 (the certificate is sensitive to the data)
controls.C7 (negative): a deliberately false stated bound is rejected; planted sorry/axiom flagged by the axiom audit

kill_and_void: no slab bound or interval is edited by hand; failures are reported
not_claimed: no claim about radiation, neutrinos, curvature or dark-energy models other than flat LCDM
the Gaussian likelihood and the DESI data vector are inputs, not theorems

amendments.change: the profile over K is centred: for each case pick an untrusted K0 > 0 (from a floating-point fit) and write K = K0 + t; with r0_j = d_j - K0 x_j, chi2 = c' - t B' + t^2 A where c' = sum P r0 r0, B' = sum P_jk (r0_j x_k + x_j r0_k), A = sum P x x, so A > 0 gives chi2 >= c' - B'^2/(4A) for every real t, i.e. every real K. The claim (all K) is unchanged.
amendments.reason: conditioning: uncentred, c = d P d and B^2/(4A) are both ~1e5 and their difference is the quantity of interest, so separate interval bounds on A and B lose ~4 eps c ~ 1e2 or more at relative width eps = 3e-4 (thousands inside a slab), which would make H7/H8 vacuous for reasons of method. Centred, c' and B' are small. Argument only; no trial computation was run.
also: smoke tests before scaling: (i) decide +kernel on the rational interval evaluator for a 2-variable expression; (ii) the S = 20000 table check alone, timed; chunks joined in two levels
the real-valued chi2 is defined as a sum over the 25 non-zero entries of the block-diagonal P, with the zero off-block structure stated in the data definition
order: H6 and H7 first, then slabs; no slab added or split without a further dated amendment
